digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and Gerrit DET review
propositions: Explicit review-plan on bugs with non-test file_impact must escalate to full blocking rubric instead of light advisory tier at both precheck and route_criteria seams, keying on persisted declared blast radius without CLI flags or schema changes.
Gerrit DET criterion blocks bug commits with >150 non-test lines lacking current or minimally-drifted plan-review attestation, with teaching-message remediation path.
Attestation verification for B2 reads cross-host via opcert_from_record and trusted_env_keyring, never via own-env plan_review_status, and applies compute_validity freshness checks.
Non-test lines are those in test/** or conftest.py; all other paths (src, scripts, docs, workflows) count as test-triggering; classification rule and threshold are single shared constant.
Verdict predicate accepts {certified, stale-code, stale-head}, flags compute_validity plan-review literals and cross-host op-cert failures, fails open only on infra unavailable/error/unknown.
Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits validates flagged set matches exactly the 13 hand-adjudicated substantive fixes with zero mechanical false positives.
